Thank you for reporting this issue. Could you please provide additional details to help us investigate?
- Detailed step-by-step reproduction instructions (e.g. how the audio was imported or opened in the project)
- The format, sample rate, and properties of the audio file used
- Project state details (e.g. is playback completely stopped, is a track or audio clip selected)
- Whether this behavior occurs persistently with every audio file or only intermittently.
